CustomField.description: Filter for the Order Form products table. False only for a Legal Monitor bundle parent line (non-component product named "Bundle" at zero) - those carry no fee and would print as a pointless zero row above the priced tier line. Everything else prints.
CustomField.formula: NOT(AND( TEXT(SBQQ__Product__r.Family) = "Subs - Legal Monitor", NOT(SBQQ__Product__r.SBQQ__Component__c), SBQQ__NetTotal__c = 0, CONTAINS(SBQQ__ProductName__c, "Bundle") ))
CustomField.label: Order Form: print row
